outline.chapter_title: Chapter 1: The Challenge of Scaling Foundation Models
outline.description: This chapter establishes the context for the research by discussing the ubiquity of large foundation models and the prohibitive costs associated with training them from scratch. It introduces the necessity of efficient adaptation paradigms.
subtopics: The Rise of Large Language and Vision Models (LLMs/VLMs)

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 2: Principles and Limitations of Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT)
outline.description: This chapter details the foundational technique, Orthogonal Finetuning, explaining its theoretical basis in preserving neural relationships and analyzing its computational drawbacks.
subtopics: Fundamental Principle: Preserving Pairwise Angles Between Neurons
- High Dimensionality Cost ($O(d^2)$ parameters for full dense matrices)
- Inductive Bias Issues in Block-Diagonal Structures,
- Loss of Expressiveness (cannot approximate arbitrary linear transforms),
- Arbitrary Sparsity Patterns lack geometric justification.
"How can we construct a dense orthogonal matrix without sacrificing parameter efficiency?"

- Sparsity Pattern as Missing Paths in Communication Graphs
